2607.07375.title: On Adversarial Vulnerability of Vision-Language Models through the Lens of Intermediate Spectral Subspaces
2607.07375.paper_summary: Adversarial vulnerability in deep neural networks (DNNs) has been studied from the perspectives of decision-boundary geometry, feature robustness, input-output Jacobians, and the instability of inverse problems. Here, we focus on the spectral structure of intermediate linear transformations that propagate information through modern DNNs, an unexplored mechanism of adversarial vulnerability. Specifically, we investigate transformer-based vision-language models, whose linear layers admit interpretable spectral decompositions and whose widespread adoption makes understanding their robustness increasingly important. We propose a white-box spectral-subspace-guided attack (SSGRA) that aligns intermediate representations with the subspace spanned by the bottom right singular vectors. Our experiments show improved attack effectiveness over existing baselines. In addition, SSGRA offers a spectral interpretation of adversarial vulnerability in VLMs, providing insights for improving their robustness.
2607.07375.paper_summary_zh: 對抗性脆弱性在深度神經網絡（DNNs）中的研究已從決策邊界幾何、特徵穩健性、輸入輸出雅可比矩陣以及反問題的不穩定性等角度進行探討。<lb/>在這裡，我們專注於通過現代DNNs 傳遞信息的中間線性變換的光譜結構，這是一種尚未探索的對抗性脆弱性機制。<lb/>具體而言，我們研究基於Transformer的視覺-語言模型，其線性層允許可解釋的光譜分解，並且其廣泛應用使得理解其穩健性變得越來越重要。<lb/>我們提出了一種白盒光譜子空間引導攻擊（SSGRA），該攻擊將中間表示與由右下角奇異向量所張成的子空間對齊。<lb/>我們的實驗顯示出相較於現有基準的攻擊效果有所改善。<lb/>此外，SSGRA 提供了對 VLMs 中對抗性脆弱性的光譜解釋，為提高其穩健性提供了見解。
